svg.metadata: {"collision_pairs": [], "height_inches": 4.7, "labels": [{"rendered": "先拼接字节，再做 UTF-8 解码", "role": "text", "source": "先拼接字节，再做 UTF-8 解码"}, {"rendered": "下面两例使用各自的词表。", "role": "text", "source": "下面两例使用各自的词表。"}, {"rendered": "ID 序列", "role": "text", "source": "ID 序列"}, {"rendered": "查表得到的字节", "role": "text", "source": "查表得到的字节"}, {"rendered": "拼接后解码", "role": "text", "source": "拼接后解码"}, {"rendered": "[257,97,99]", "role": "text", "source": "[257,97,99]"}, {"rendered": "b\"abab\" + b\"a\" + b\"c\"", "role": "text", "source": "b\"abab\" + b\"a\" + b\"c\""}, {"rendered": "\"ababac\"", "role": "text", "source": "\"ababac\""}, {"rendered": "[228,256]", "role": "text", "source": "[228,256]"}, {"rendered": "[228] + [189,160]", "role": "text", "source": "[228] + [189,160]"}, {"rendered": "\"你\"", "role": "text", "source": "\"你\""}, {"rendered": "第二例的字节：228 | 189 160", "role": "text", "source": "第二例的字节：228 | 189 160"}, {"rendered": "两块单独都不是完整 UTF-8 字符，合起来才是“你”。", "role": "text", "source": "两块单独都不是完整 UTF-8 字符，合起来才是“你”。"}, {"rendered": "ID 256 的含义必须由当前词表确定。", "role": "text", "source": "ID 256 的含义必须由当前词表确定。"}], "language": "zh-CN", "math_engine": "XeLaTeX with unicode-math", "minimum_print_font_pt": 10.200000000000001, "name": "02-06-join-before-decode.zh-CN", "numeric_data_sha256": "5b0d8478ceb0824459e8a18aa848d7597a336c58ac6db5b5c536750ba0d98cbd", "outside_labels": [], "rendered_fonts": ["STSongti-SC-Bold", "STSongti-SC-Regular", "TimesNewRomanPS-BoldMT", "TimesNewRomanPSMT"], "typography_sha256": "41d401d817f6d65a7cda1fc30c8c4be889e4d32284b5078fcf5e5e51af2166d5", "vector_pdf_sha256": "2a86d4226eefe5e5469b13073bff4d754252385d012d2d43c3fd5027194f9195", "width_inches": 7.2}
